_notes: Vanilla randomTick of the origin's state, recorded by the asset generator's GrowingPlantTickFixtures.java against a block view of the case's setup (air elsewhere, void air outside the build height of -64 to 319), with every raw brightness the case's light (15 by default), the spread_vines rule as spreadVines says (true by default), and a legacy random seeded with seed as both the tick's random and the level's. ticks is the state's isRandomlyTicking; a state that doesn't tick isn't ticked, and a case without an origin ticks nothing. After the tick, each of the case's actions sets its state with Level.setBlock and UPDATE_ALL, or without a state removes the block (Level.removeBlock). draws lists each draw in order with its bound and result, the shape updates' included. writes are the block changes in order with their update flags, including those of the neighbour shape updates they cause (neighbour notifications are not run). scheduled lists the block and fluid ticks scheduled. after holds the final state of every setup or written position.
